scope: read-only secured raw event analysis; no simulation
limits: one seed in main, one separate pilot seed; paired starts not independent population samples
political target differs intentionally in half pilot; do not pool pilot as city difficulty
conditional title medians exclude censored cases; show counts
early arms is a real choice with protection and capacity effects, not a pure cash experiment
wealth180/360 is the last observed action before that day, not exact-day interpolation
visited ports are recomputed from actual arrival destinations, not runner departure observations
